areaGuide.title: Living in Subang Jaya – Complete Guide to Room Rental, Condo & Apartment Rental in Selangor
areaGuide.description: Subang Jaya is one of the most established and highly sought-after residential and commercial townships in Selangor, offering a wide variety of room rentals, condominium rentals, serviced apartments and family homes for students, working professionals, expatriates and families. Located approximately 20 kilometres from Kuala Lumpur City Centre, Subang Jaya is renowned for its excellent transportation connectivity, world-class universities, vibrant commercial districts, shopping malls and modern residential developments. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Subang Jaya, single room near SS15 LRT Station, fully furnished condominium room, studio apartment, serviced residence, affordable apartment rental or luxury condominium, Subang Jaya provides accommodation options for every lifestyle and budget. The township is particularly popular among students studying at Taylor's University, Monash University Malaysia, Sunway University, INTI International University and UOW Malaysia KDU University College, as well as professionals working in Sunway, Petaling Jaya, Shah Alam, KL Sentral, Cyberjaya and Kuala Lumpur City Centre. Residents enjoy excellent connectivity through the Kelana Jaya LRT Line, KTM Komuter, BRT Sunway Line, Federal Highway, NPE, LDP, KESAS Highway, ELITE Highway and NKVE. Major landmarks including Sunway Pyramid, Empire Shopping Gallery, Subang Parade, Da Men Mall, Sunway Medical Centre, Taylor's Lakeside Campus and Sunway Lagoon further enhance the area's appeal. With its combination of education, employment, shopping, entertainment, public transportation and modern lifestyle facilities, Subang Jaya continues to be one of the strongest and most competitive rental property markets in the Klang Valley.
